textos: A principal software engineer with over 19 years of experience across backend and frontend. I design architecture that stays simple as products and teams grow, focusing on technical strategy, clear system design, and the long-term decisions that keep code maintainable.

Currently at House of Doge, responsible for the architecture and technical strategy of a greenfield React Native platform — building products for Ðogecoin to increase utility and adoption. Previously at OneTwo, building the automation platform ANZ Australia uses to process home loans. Previously at GetSetUp, DDB, and more.
Passionate about innovation and tackling new challenges through both technical and creative solutions.
